disclosure.title: Share your location during deliveries
disclosure.lead: To keep your delivery visible to JOVO while you drive, JOVO needs to collect your location even when the app is closed or in the background, for example while you use a navigation app.
disclosure.what: Your precise location (GPS position), about every 10 seconds.
disclosure.when: Only while you have an active delivery, including when JOVO is closed or not on screen. It is not collected when you have no delivery, and it stops as soon as the delivery is completed or cancelled.
disclosure.why: So JOVO dispatch can see where your delivery is, help if something goes wrong, and keep customers' orders on track.
disclosure.who: JOVO staff in the admin console. It is not shown to customers or shared with advertisers.
disclosure.stop: You can say no now and still deliver. You can turn location off at any time in your phone's settings. Signing out stops it immediately.
disclosure.androidHint: After you continue, choose "Allow all the time" on the next screen so location keeps working while you navigate.
disclosure.iosHint: After you continue, choose "Always" so location keeps working while you navigate.

tracking.reminderBody: Your location is shared with dispatch only while a delivery is active.
